picks.title: General Catalyst leads $1.1B round into 2-month-old River AI
picks.why_it_matters: A $1.1B seed-stage round for an xAI co-founder's personal agents startup signals that top-tier VCs are making massive bets on agentic AI as the next platform shift, compressing timelines for early-stage competitors in the space.

picks.title: Tech giants are pushing for a new AI agent incident reporting framework
picks.why_it_matters: A 120+ company coalition proposing AI agent safety standards suggests regulatory frameworks are forming now—startups building in the agent space should design for compliance early or risk being locked out of enterprise deals.

picks.title: Accel closes oversubscribed $550M India fund within weeks, 19 months after its last
picks.why_it_matters: Rapid oversubscription of a major India fund with 55% of the prior fund still undeployed signals strong LP appetite for emerging market tech and increased competition for early-stage deals in the region.
